ov: Small, shrimp-like marine crustaceans found in every ocean, near the bottom of the food chain. They eat phytoplankton and are the main food of many larger animals.
rg: All oceans; the Antarctic krill in the Southern Ocean.
fx: The name comes from a Norwegian word meaning “small fry of fish”.
